arguments.value: Benson Everett Legg (born 1947 in Baltimore, Maryland) served as a United States District Judge for the District of Maryland from 1991 until his retirement in 2013, including as chief judge from 2003 to 2010 and senior judge beginning in 2012. He earned his A.B. from Princeton University in 1970 and his J.D. from the University of Virginia School of Law in 1973. After clerking for Judge Frank A. Kaufman of the U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland, he practiced privately in Baltimore from 1975 to 1991 before his appointment to the federal bench.
